descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Asociat
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Industria prelucrătoare
Schaeffler is a dynamic global technology company and its success has been a result of its entrepreneurial spirit and long history of private ownership. Does that sound interesting to you? As a partner to all of the major automobile manufacturers, as well as key players in the aerospace and industrial sectors, we offer you many development opportunities.
 Your Key Responsibilities
 Design, implement, and maintain automated CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitHub Actions and Jenkins.
 Develop and enhance features in enterprise applications, including writing tests and maintaining clear technical documentation.
 Develop, maintain, and operate containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes.
 Collaborate with team members to improve application architecture, deployment processes, and operational readiness.
 Monitor application and infrastructure health; configure logging, metrics, alerting, and dashboards to support availability and performance.
 Conduct code reviews to ensure code quality, maintainability, and adherence to established standards and best practices.
 Collaborate on improving the automation level of our operations towards self-service.
 Ensure compliance with security policies and standards, working with security and compliance teams as necessary.
 Participate in the use and continuous improvement of agile methods such as Scrum and Kanban to enhance team collaboration and delivery efficiency.
 Your Qualifications
 University degree in (business) informatics or alternative training with relevant professional experience in this field
 At least 5 years of relevant professional experience in this field
 Strong automation mindset, with experience designing, implementing, and operating DevOps workflows using CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions and Jenkins
 Hands-on experience with container technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes
 Proven experience working with managed cloud services on Azure and/or AWS, preferably using infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform
 Experience implementing monitoring, logging, and alerting for cloud-based applications
 Sound understanding of the fundamentals of agentic AI and its application principles.
 Professional experience developing enterprise applications in at least one programming language, such as Python or TypeScript
 Proficiency in using AI-powered tools such as GitHub Copilot to support software development and improve DevOps workflows
 Fluent in English, spoken and written
 Strong hands-on attitude combined with good analytical skills
 Ability to learn new technologies and skills (T-Shape philosophy)
 Proficiency in agile methodologies, with experience working effectively within agile teams and environments, fostering an agile mindset in daily work.
 Our Offering
Onboarding & Integration: we help you settle in quickly through our onboarding program and a team that supports you;
Health & Life Insurance: we provide private health plans and life insurance, so you can have peace of mind;
Discounts: enjoy discounts from our partners on activities, trainings, goods etc.;
Bookster Subscription: are you a passionate reader? Then you can borrow your favorite books from the Bookster Library;
Professional Development: with our variety of projects and teams, you'll be able to learn new skills, develop and shape the career path that fits you best;
Bonuses: performance bonuses reward your achievements, and thorough referral bonuses we thank you for helping our team grow;
Gift for Special Occasions: celebrate Easter, 8th of March or the Winter Holiday;
Vacation Days: we truly believe in long-term partnerships, and we’re committed to supporting your well-being with a generous vacation policy from the start of your journey with us;
Meal Tickets: we’re happy to offer meal tickets as part of your everyday benefits, helping make your lunch breaks more enjoyable;
Flexibility: you can balance your work and personal life with arrangements tailored to your job and responsibilities.
 As a global company with employees around the world, it is important to us that we treat each other with respect and value all ideas and perspectives. By appreciating our differences, we inspire creativity and drive innovation. In this way, we contribute to sustainable value creation for our stakeholders and society as a whole. Together, we advance how the world moves.
Exciting assignments and outstanding development opportunities await you because we impact the future with innovation. We look forward to your application.
